title: NDA Standard Summary — Output Schema (nda-standard-summary)
description: Output schema for sprk_analysisaction sprk_actioncode='nda-standard-summary' (ai-advanced-capabilities-nda-r1 task 021, UC3). MIRRORS VERBATIM the outputSchema in infra/dataverse/actions/nda-standard-summary.action.json. Azure OpenAI Structured Outputs compatible: additionalProperties:false, object-level required arrays, no anyOf/oneOf/discriminator. CLOSED, MINIMAL CONTRACT: exactly {overview, sections[{topic, explanation, standardRefs}]} — deliberately smaller than nda-review's per-finding contract since this Action never reviews a document (no sectionRef/quotedText/riskLevel: there is no document span to cite or risk to rate). No disclaimer field: the not-legal-advice framing is a systemPrompt posture + the shared fixed review-summary-panel constant (see the Action's $comment-disclaimer). Advisory determinism (ADR-039 amendment): light paraphrase/synthesis for plain-language readability on the Fast tier, every stated position grounded and cited via standardRefs to a real clause (B1-B15) of the supplied Spaarke NDA standard (KNW-011).
$comment-required: Object-level required array only — property-level boolean 'required' is FORBIDDEN.

overview.description: 1-2 plain-language sentences framing what the summary below covers. No legal jargon.

sections.description: Plain-language topics covering the firm's default NDA positions, thematically grouped (prefer fewer, well-grounded sections over one per clause). Omit clause B16 (mechanical drafting-integrity checks) — not a negotiable position.

topic.description: Short plain-language topic label (e.g. 'What counts as confidential'). Not legal terminology.

explanation.description: Plain-language explanation of the firm's default position on this topic and why it's the default, for a non-lawyer reader. Grounded fact only; no fabricated rationale.

standardRefs.description: The firm-standard clause(s) (B1-B15; B16 excluded from this summary) this section summarizes. At least one. Must be real clauses of the supplied Spaarke NDA standard (KNW-011).
